title: Aajao Ali Asghar Aajao Mere Laal
body:
Aajao Ali Asghar Asws. Aajao Mere Laal.
asghar Asws. Tujhe Amma Ki Nazar Dhoond Rahi Hai.
1.har God Mein Uth Uth Ke Behen Dekh Rahi Hai.
ay Laal Sakina S.a. Bhi Tujhe Dhoond Rahi Hai.
aa Aake Behen Teri Tujhe Pooch Rahi Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hatho'n Pa Shahe Dee'n Ke Tu Dam Tod Chuka Hai. phir Bhi Mera Dil Mujhse Yahi Bol Raha Hai.
tu Lautke Aayega Mujhe Aas Badi Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jhoola Mai Jhulaongi Tujhe Lout Ke Aaja.
lori Mai Sunaongi Tujhe Lout Ke Aaja.
aa Der Na Kar Maa Dare Zindaa'n Pe Khadi Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Chehra Tera Dekhungi To Jee Jaoungi Beta.
warna Teri Furqat Mein Mai Marjaoungi Beta.
ab Shaam O Seher Mera Faqat Vird Yahi Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bano Ki Museebat Pe Har Ek Aankh Hai Purnam. aur Anjuman E Asghari Karne Lagi Matam.
faiyaz Fizaoun Mein Sadaa Ab Bhi Yahi Hai.
